description: Exact native Core JSON records (not captured HTTP envelopes). Construct source file is an array. Source paths and Git blob SHAs retained for verification.

trait.description: On your turn when you take the Attack action, you can replace one of the attacks with your Breath Weapon. Targets in the area defined by your dragon ancestry make a Dexterity saving throw against DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Constitution modifier. A failed save deals damage of your dragon ancestry's type; a successful save takes half damage. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus and all expended uses return after a Long Rest.

originComposition.notes: Player-directed inheritance may choose the complete ordinary Breath Weapon area and its damage type from eligible configured contributor offers. Preserve one complete action, damage progression, save, and use pool. This does not independently authorize a mixed trait grant or confer resistance, warding, or other Dragonborn adaptations.

trait.description: While in contact with a configured material, activate Tremorsense at the configured range for 10 minutes as a Bonus Action. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

trait.name: Human Determination
trait.description: Before making an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you may choose to make that roll with Advantage. You can use this ability once per Short or Long Rest. You must declare its use before rolling; it does not stack with existing Advantage, consume an Action or Reaction, or grant an ability-score increase.
Increase maximum hit points by 1 for each character level.

trait.name: Adaptable Learning
trait.description: Gain four additional skill ranks to allocate at character level 1. At each subsequent character level, gain one additional skill rank to allocate. These ranks supplement normal advancement and are allocated by the player under the usual skill-rank limits.
At character level 5, gain Darkness. Cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest, or with an appropriate spell slot. This does not grant the ability to see through magical Darkness.
trait.name: Darkness

trait.description: Choose one of Disguise Self, Silent Image, or Ventriloquism as an innate spell at character creation. Cast the chosen first-level illusion once without a spell slot per Long Rest. This trait does not itself grant spell slots or slot casting.
Know one Wizard cantrip; replace it with another Wizard cantrip after each Long Rest.
You have 50 percent resistance to the damage type configured from the selected ancestry or other verified lineage source.

trait.name: Born of Ice
trait.description: You have 50 percent resistance to Cold damage.

trait.name: Versatile
trait.description: At character creation, choose one additional Origin feat. This choice is in addition to any feat granted by your other character-creation selections.

trait.name: Low-Light Vision
trait.description: You perceive Dim Light as Bright Light, without a separate range limit. This does not permit you to see through Darkness.

record.name: Construct Optical Sight
record.rulesStatus: candidate physical functional trait; nonvisual conditions apply; no special vision or bonus

trait.name: Ordinary Optical Sight
trait.description: While the installed eye is operational and exposed to sufficient visible light, its user can see through that optical interface. This does not grant darkvision, low-light vision, blindsight, or an independent Perception bonus.

record.name: Construct Physical Manipulation
record.rulesStatus: candidate physical functional trait; no bonus action or weapon proficiency

trait.name: Physical Manipulation
trait.description: While the installed manipulator and its required actuation and control support are operational, it can physically grasp and handle ordinary objects within its reach. This does not grant extra actions, additional hands for equipment rules, weapon proficiency, or any ability-score increase.

record.name: Construct Ordinary Communication
record.rulesStatus: starting-playtest functional trait; no additional language entitlement

trait.name: Ordinary Communication
trait.description: While its control interface is operational, the Construct can communicate audibly in languages it already knows. This does not grant language proficiencies, telepathy, or unusual communication ranges.

record.name: Construct Ordinary Ground Movement
record.rulesStatus: starting-playtest functional trait; movement and structural support integration remain provisional

trait.name: Ordinary Ground Movement
trait.description: While this locomotion component is operational, it supports ordinary ground movement with a nominal 30-foot walking speed, subject to other applicable movement and physical-support rules. This does not waive body-mass limitations or grant movement while disabled.

record.name: Construct Climbing Movement
record.rulesStatus: provisional playable movement-speed candidate; mobility, energy and physical-load balance require integrated testing

trait.name: Climbing Movement
trait.description: Supports climbing on compatible surfaces while installed and operational. An authorized climbing speed and surface limitations are required before the character can use this mode; no walking speed, fall protection, or universal adhesion is granted.

record.name: Construct Flying Movement
record.rulesStatus: provisional playable movement-speed candidate; mobility, energy and physical-load balance require integrated testing

trait.name: Flying Movement
trait.description: Supports aerial movement while installed and operational, pending an authorized flying speed and lift/load rules. Does not grant hover, immunity to falling, or an unrestricted ability to fly.

record.name: Construct Burrowing Movement
record.rulesStatus: provisional playable movement-speed candidate; mobility, energy and physical-load balance require integrated testing

trait.name: Burrowing Movement
trait.description: Supports excavating movement in author-permitted material while installed and operational. Requires an authorized burrowing speed and permitted substrates; does not grant universal stone penetration, permanent tunnels, or suffocation protection.

record.name: Construct Swimming Movement
record.rulesStatus: provisional playable movement-speed candidate; mobility, energy and physical-load balance require integrated testing

trait.name: Swimming Movement
trait.description: Supports self-propelled aquatic movement while installed and operational, pending an authorized swimming speed and applicable water conditions. Does not grant underwater breathing, pressure protection, or water breathing.

record.name: Dwarf
reviewNotes: Darkvision reduced from 120 to 60 feet; underground Dwarf Ancestry distribution remains open. Walking Speed reduced to 25 feet in the approved comparative Species review.
The maximum-HP rule's application to NPCs or monster Hit Dice remains unresolved.

Approved: Dwarven Fortitude is an inherent biological adaptation allowing one available Hit Die to be spent for healing when taking Dodge in combat, using the Hit Die roll plus Constitution modifier (minimum 1 HP regained). The original feat's ability-score increase is omitted; the Dodge action and Hit Die are not granted by the trait.

Approved trial repricing: Level-Based Vitality increases from 1 to 3 points without changing +1 maximum HP per character level. Dwarven Fortitude costs 4 points. Base Dwarf is 17/18; Hill Dwarf, including Stability, is 18/18. These are provisional playtest values.
Needs review; pending approval — Squat Nimbleness remains a separately considered historical feat; no additional movement or grapple mechanic is granted.

record.name: Rock Gnome
reviewNotes: Approved final Rock Gnome biological package: shared Tremorsense configured for earth or stone, Natural Climber (15-foot Climb Speed), and one permanent Natural Trickster spell choice with one free casting per Long Rest.

Trial allocation: shared Gnome 9, configured Tremorsense 4, Natural Climber 2, Natural Trickster 2, source-bound spellcasting Ability 1; total 18/18. The same 60-foot range and use schedule are preserved for Dwarves and Rock Gnomes.
